name: Defguard Open-Source WireGuard Access Management
free_limit: Free self-hosted open-source core for WireGuard-based remote access, identity and access management, and authentication; no software subscription for the AGPL-licensed community components.
watch_out: Requires operator-provided server, network and WireGuard infrastructure. AGPL obligations apply to the open-source core; the enterprise directory and enterprise-only features are separately licensed. The paid Business/Enterprise offerings must not be confused with the free open-source core; consult official feature boundaries before deployment.
